definitions.explanation: Muscle stiffness and tension in the shoulder and neck area, often caused by poor posture, stress, or desk work.

examples.japanese: パソコン{作業|さぎょう}で{肩凝|かたこ}りになった。
examples.english: I got stiff shoulders from working on the computer.

examples.japanese: マッサージで{肩凝|かたこ}りを{解消|かいしょう}した。
examples.english: I relieved my stiff shoulders with a massage.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{肩|かた} (shoulder) + {凝|こ}り (stiffness) - from {凝|こ}る (to stiffen)

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as {肩凝り|かたこり} or {肩こり|かたこり} (with hiragana for {凝|こ}り)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{肩凝|かたこ}り is an extremely common complaint in Japan, particularly among office workers. Massage parlors, heat patches, and stretching exercises targeting {肩凝|かたこ}り are widely available.

RELATED BODY COMPLAINTS:
・{腰痛|ようつう} - back pain
・{頭痛|ずつう} - headache
・{寝違|ねちが}え - stiff neck from sleeping wrong

COLLOCATIONS:
・{肩凝|かたこ}りがひどい - have severe shoulder stiffness
・{肩凝|かたこ}りを{解消|かいしょう}する - to relieve stiff shoulders
